title: Oozy Cheesy Norwegian Cheese Casserole
description: A weeknight Norwegian dish featuring tomato puree and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a comforting dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the tomato puree, Gruyere cheese, and Jarlsberg cheese.
Add the sauce to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with breadcrumbs if using.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
